name: marble
summary: Polished marble: the grey and the gold-veined black floors inside Devias's church and halls.
why: Roughness 0.35. Polished stone that is walked on, shinier than flagstone's worked 0.72 -
these are the finest floors in MU's first three maps, and they should catch the lamps.
Depth 0.04, near nothing. A polished slab is flat; its veins are colour inside the
stone, and read as height they would turn the floor into a relief map.
Range 0.05. A polished floor is polished all over.
